## Dashboards

Every dashboard below runs the real cards against a simulated home, so tap, drag and hold them. Build yours from posters, tiles, rooms and flows that take your theme, and lay them out in any grid with the [layout card](/cards/layout-card).

### Home

Put the whole house on one screen. A [poster](/cards/entity-card#poster) gives an entity, the weather, the sun, the wind or the rain one large value, a pill and a curve; [heading cards](/cards/heading-card) carry the clock, the people and what is playing; a [swipe card](/cards/swipe-card) fits several cards into one cell.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Home
      subtitle: "{{ now().strftime('%A, %e %B') }}"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: subtitle
      badge_style: outline
      badge_size: l
      badges_position: inline
      badges:
        - { entity: person.alex, show_entity_picture: true, show_name: true, rules: &home [{ state: home, color: green, label: Home }, { state: not_home, color: grey, label: Away }] }
        - { entity: person.sam, show_entity_picture: true, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: person.kim, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: media_player.living_room_tv, name: TV, icon: mdi:television-play, attribute: media_title, show_name: true, visibility: [{ condition: state, entity: media_player.living_room_tv, state: playing }] }
        - { entity: group.downstairs_lights, name: Lights on, visual: count, show_name: true, color: amber }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:weather-card-pro
          entity: weather.home
          name: Outside
          layout: poster
          temperature_rules:
            - { below: 5, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 20, color: teal, label: Mild }
            - { above: 20, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - type: custom:sun-path-card-pro
          layout: poster
        - type: custom:wind-card-pro
          entity: sensor.wind_speed
          direction: sensor.wind_direction
          gust: sensor.wind_gust
          name: Wind
          layout: poster
          visual: flow
          rules:
            - { below: 5, color: blue-grey, label: Calm }
            - { below: 20, color: teal, label: Breeze }
            - { below: 35, color: amber, label: Fresh }
            - { above: 35, color: orange, label: Strong }
        - type: custom:rain-card-pro
          entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
          today: sensor.rain_today
          wind: sensor.wind_speed
          direction: sensor.wind_direction
          name: Rain
          layout: poster
          visual: flow
          rules:
            - { below: 0.1, color: blue-grey, label: Dry }
            - { below: 2.5, color: light-blue, label: Light }
            - { above: 2.5, color: blue, label: Heavy }
        - type: custom:multi-trend-card-pro
          title: Power
          icon: mdi:flash
          color: amber
          hours_to_show: 12
          layout: poster
          entities:
            - { entity: sensor.power_consumption, name: Home, color: amber }
            - { entity: sensor.heat_pump_power, name: Heat pump, color: deep-orange }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.ev_battery
          name: Car
          icon: mdi:car-electric
          layout: poster
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
            - { above: 20, color: green }
          badges:
            - entity: binary_sensor.ev_plugged
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: green, icon: mdi:power-plug, label: Plugged in }
                - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power-plug-off, label: Unplugged }
            - sensor.ev_range
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: vacuum.robot
          name: Robot
          layout: poster
          control: buttons
          control_options:
            - { icon: mdi:play, action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: vacuum.start, target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot } } }
            - { icon: mdi:home-import-outline, action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: vacuum.return_to_base, target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot } } }
          rules:
            - { state: cleaning, color: teal }
            - { state: docked, color: grey }
          badges:
            - { entity: sensor.robot_battery, visual: ring }
            - sensor.robot_current_room
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.dishwasher_status
          name: Dishwasher
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ states('sensor.dishwasher_status') | replace('power_off', 'Off') | replace('run', 'Running') | replace('end', 'Done') }}"
          rules:
            - { state: Running, color: green, icon: mdi:dishwasher }
            - { state: Done, color: teal, icon: mdi:dishwasher-alert }
            - { state: "Off", color: grey, icon: mdi:dishwasher-off }
          badges:
            - { entity: sensor.dishwasher_finishes, format: relative, icon: mdi:timer-outline }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: lock.front_door
          name: Front door
          layout: poster
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: locked, color: green, icon: mdi:shield-lock }
            - { state: unlocked, color: red, icon: mdi:shield-lock-open }
          badges:
            - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
          name: Kitchen speaker
          layout: poster
          icon: mdi:speaker
          attribute: media_title
          control: buttons
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: green, label: Playing }
            - { state: idle, color: grey, label: Idle }
        - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
          title: Living room
          icon: mdi:sofa
          layout: table
          vertical_align: bottom
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          entities:
            - entity: light.desk_lamp
              name: Desk lamp
              control: toggle
              rules: &lamp
                - { state: "on", color: amber }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
            - entity: light.living_room
              name: Ceiling
              control: slider
              rules: *lamp
            - name: Scenes
              icon: mdi:palette
              control: buttons
              control_options:
                - { entity: scene.bright, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny, color: amber }
                - { entity: scene.dinner, icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife, color: deep-orange }
                - { entity: scene.movie_night, icon: mdi:movie-open, color: deep-purple }
                - { entity: scene.good_night, icon: mdi:weather-night, color: indigo }
        - type: custom:swipe-card-pro
          per_page: 1
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: climate.bedroom
              name: Bedroom
              layout: poster
              attribute: current_temperature
              unit: °C
              decimals: 1
              control: stepper
              color: indigo
              badges:
                - entity: climate.bedroom
                  attribute: hvac_action
                  rules:
                    - { state: heating, color: deep-orange, icon: mdi:fire, label: Heating }
                    - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power, label: "Off" }
            - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
              title: Kitchen
              icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
              layout: table
              vertical_align: bottom
              show_value: false
              entities:
                - { entity: light.kitchen, name: Light, control: slider, color: amber }
                - { entity: switch.coffee_machine, name: Coffee, icon: mdi:coffee, control: toggle, color: brown }
                - { entity: input_select.house_mode, name: Mode, control: select }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: media_player.living_room_tv
              name: Living room TV
              icon: mdi:television-play
              attribute: media_title
              control: auto
              rules:
                - { state: playing, color: deep-purple }
                - { state: paused, color: grey }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: fan.bedroom
              name: Bedroom fan
              layout: poster
              attribute: percentage
              unit: "%"
              control: segments
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: cyan }
                - { state: "off", color: grey }
```

</DashboardGrid>

### Energy

Follow every watt and every kilowatt-hour. The [power flow](/cards/power-flow-card) shows where power goes right now; the [energy flow](/cards/energy-flow-card) splits a day, week, month or year the way Home Assistant's Energy dashboard does, with a picker to step through them.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Energy
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.energy_today') }} kWh today · {{ states('sensor.electricity_price') }} €/kWh now"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:power-flow-card-pro
          title: Now
          icon: mdi:flash
          home: sensor.power_consumption
          view_layout: { span: [2, 6] }
          sources:
            - { type: solar, entity: sensor.solar_power }
            - { type: battery, power: sensor.battery_power, soc: sensor.battery_soc }
            - { type: grid, power: sensor.grid_power, price: sensor.electricity_price }
          consumers:
            - { entity: sensor.heat_pump_power, name: Heat pump, icon: mdi:heat-pump }
            - { entity: sensor.washer_power, name: Washer, icon: mdi:washing-machine }
            - { entity: sensor.office_power, name: Office, icon: mdi:monitor }
            - { entity: sensor.ev_charger_power, name: EV charger, icon: mdi:ev-station }
          rules:
            - { below: 500, color: green, label: Quiet }
            - { below: 3000, color: amber, label: Busy }
            - { above: 3000, color: red, label: Peak }
        - type: custom:energy-flow-card-pro
          title: Today
          icon: mdi:calendar-today
          view_layout: { span: [2, 6] }
          home: sensor.home_energy
          sources:
            - { type: solar, entity: sensor.solar_energy }
            - { type: battery, charge: sensor.battery_charge_energy, discharge: sensor.battery_discharge_energy, soc: sensor.battery_soc }
            - { type: grid, import: sensor.grid_import_energy, export: sensor.grid_export_energy }
          consumers:
            - { entity: sensor.heat_pump_energy, name: Heat pump, icon: mdi:heat-pump }
            - { entity: sensor.washer_energy, name: Washer, icon: mdi:washing-machine }
            - { entity: sensor.office_energy, name: Office, icon: mdi:monitor }
            - { entity: sensor.ev_charger_energy, name: EV charger, icon: mdi:ev-station }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.solar_power
          name: Solar
          icon: mdi:solar-power-variant
          layout: poster
          decimals: 1
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 12
          rules:
            - { below: 0.1, color: grey, label: Idle }
            - { above: 0.1, color: amber, label: Producing }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.grid_power
          name: Grid
          icon: mdi:transmission-tower
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: columns
          hours_to_show: 12
          bucket_minutes: 30
          rules:
            - { below: 0, color: green, label: Exporting }
            - { above: 0, color: blue, label: Importing }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.battery_soc
          name: Battery
          icon: mdi:home-battery
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: bar
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
            - { below: 50, color: amber, label: Half }
            - { above: 50, color: green, label: Full }
          badges:
            - { entity: sensor.battery_power, format: power, icon: mdi:flash }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.heat_pump_power
          name: Heat pump
          icon: mdi:heat-pump
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 12
          color: deep-orange
```

</DashboardGrid>

### Living room

Run a room without opening a dialog. Switches, sliders, steppers, speeds and your own scene buttons sit right on the cards ([controls](/cards/controls)), [rules](/cards/entity-options#rules) colour every value, and gauges, columns, bars and curves show where it stands.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Living room
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.living_room_temperature') }} °C · {{ states('sensor.living_room_humidity') }} % humidity · {{ states('sensor.living_room_co2') }} ppm CO₂"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
          title: Scenes & modes
          icon: mdi:palette
          vertical_align: center
          hover: true
          view_layout: { span: [2, 4] }
          show_value: false
          sections:
            - layout: row
              align: stretch
              name_position: below
              entities:
                - { entity: scene.bright, name: Bright, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny, color: amber, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.dimmed, name: Dimmed, icon: mdi:lightbulb-on-50, color: orange, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.dinner, name: Dinner, icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife, color: deep-orange, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.movie_night, name: Movie, icon: mdi:movie-open, color: deep-purple, control: button }
            - layout: row
              divider: true
              align: stretch
              name_position: below
              entities:
                - { entity: input_boolean.night_mode, name: Night, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: indigo }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.guest_mode, name: Guests, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: pink }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.away_mode, name: Away, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode, name: Vacation, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: teal }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
          name: Temperature
          icon: mdi:thermometer
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
          layout: poster
          decimals: 1
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 24
          rules:
            - { below: 18, color: blue, label: Cool }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_humidity
          name: Humidity
          icon: mdi:water-percent
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: gauge
          min: 0
          max: 100
          rules:
            - { below: 40, color: amber, label: Dry }
            - { below: 60, color: teal, label: Good }
            - { above: 60, color: blue, label: Humid }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.living_room
          name: Ceiling
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.living_room', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: &light
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.desk_lamp
          name: Desk lamp
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.desk_lamp', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: *light
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining table
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.dining_table', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: *light
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:blinds-horizontal
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          color: indigo
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_co2
          name: Air
          icon: mdi:molecule-co2
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: columns
          hours_to_show: 12
          bucket_minutes: 30
          rules:
            - { below: 800, color: green, label: Fresh }
            - { below: 1200, color: amber, label: Stuffy }
            - { above: 1200, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: climate.living_room
          name: Thermostat
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_temperature
          unit: °C
          decimals: 1
          visual: bar
          min: 15
          max: 28
          control: stepper
          color: deep-orange
          badges:
            - entity: climate.living_room
              attribute: hvac_action
              rules:
                - { state: heating, color: deep-orange, icon: mdi:fire, label: Heating }
                - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:fire-off, label: Idle }
                - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power, label: "Off" }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: fan.living_room
          name: Fan
          layout: poster
          attribute: percentage
          unit: "%"
          control: segments
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: cyan }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - type: custom:layout-card-pro
          rows: [1fr, 1fr, 1fr]
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: media_player.living_room_tv
              name: TV
              icon: mdi:television-play
              attribute: media_title
              color: deep-purple
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
              name: Speaker
              icon: mdi:speaker
              attribute: media_title
              color: green
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: switch.coffee_machine
              name: Coffee machine
              icon: mdi:coffee
              control: toggle
              control_position: lead
              color: brown
```

</DashboardGrid>

### Weather

Read the weather at a glance. The [weather card](/cards/weather-card) forecasts by the hour and the day, the [wind](/cards/wind-card) and the [rain](/cards/rain-card) move as animated fields, the [sun path](/cards/sun-path-card) and the [sun azimuth](/cards/sun-azimuth-card) show where the sun is and which walls it lights, and status strips colour a day of any sensor.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Weather
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.outdoor_temperature') }} °C · wind {{ states('sensor.wind_speed') }} km/h · {{ states('sensor.rain_today') }} mm rain today"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:weather-card-pro
          entity: weather.home
          name: Outside
          view_layout: { span: [2, 4] }
          temperature_rules:
            - { below: 5, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 20, color: teal, label: Mild }
            - { above: 20, color: orange, label: Warm }
          sections:
            - { type: hero }
            - { type: forecast, mode: hourly, layout: horizontal, hours: 6, title: Next 6 hours, divider: true, show: [], icon_size: 32 }
        - type: custom:sun-path-card-pro
          layout: poster
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
        - type: custom:sun-azimuth-card-pro
          show_summary: false
          camera: 280
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
        - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
          title: Last 24 hours
          icon: mdi:chart-timeline
          view_layout: { span: [2, 6] }
          hours_to_show: 24
          bucket_minutes: 30
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.outdoor_temperature
              name: Temperature
              decimals: 1
              visual: strip
              rules:
                - { below: 5, color: blue, icon: mdi:thermometer-low }
                - { below: 18, color: light-blue, icon: mdi:thermometer }
                - { below: 25, color: green, icon: mdi:thermometer }
                - { above: 25, color: orange, icon: mdi:thermometer-high }
            - entity: sensor.wind_speed
              name: Wind
              decimals: 0
              visual: strip
              rules:
                - { below: 10, color: blue-grey, icon: mdi:weather-windy }
                - { below: 25, color: teal, icon: mdi:weather-windy }
                - { above: 25, color: orange, icon: mdi:weather-windy-variant }
            - entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
              name: Rain
              decimals: 1
              visual: strip
              rules:
                - { below: 0.1, color: grey, icon: mdi:weather-cloudy }
                - { above: 0.1, color: blue, icon: mdi:weather-rainy }
            - entity: sensor.illuminance
              name: Daylight
              decimals: 0
              visual: strip
              rules:
                - { below: 10, color: blue-grey, icon: mdi:weather-night }
                - { below: 1000, color: blue, icon: mdi:weather-sunset }
                - { below: 20000, color: amber, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny }
                - { above: 20000, color: orange, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny }
        - type: custom:rain-card-pro
          entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
          today: sensor.rain_today
          wind: sensor.wind_speed
          direction: sensor.wind_direction
          name: Rain
          layout: poster
          visual: flow
          rules:
            - { below: 0.1, color: blue-grey, label: Dry }
            - { below: 2.5, color: light-blue, label: Light }
            - { above: 2.5, color: blue, label: Heavy }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.pressure
          name: Pressure
          icon: mdi:gauge
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 24
          color: indigo
        - type: custom:wind-card-pro
          entity: sensor.wind_speed
          direction: sensor.wind_direction
          gust: sensor.wind_gust
          name: Wind
          layout: poster
          visual: flow
          rules:
            - { below: 5, color: blue-grey, label: Calm }
            - { below: 20, color: teal, label: Breeze }
            - { below: 35, color: amber, label: Fresh }
            - { above: 35, color: orange, label: Strong }
        - type: custom:layout-card-pro
          rows: [1fr, 1fr, 1fr]
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.uv_index
              name: UV index
              icon: mdi:sun-wireless
              decimals: 1
              unit: ""
              visual: ring
              min: 0
              max: 11
              rules:
                - { below: 3, color: green, label: Low }
                - { below: 6, color: amber, label: Moderate }
                - { below: 8, color: orange, label: High }
                - { above: 8, color: red, label: Very high }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
```
